standard.summary: （实验性）BP-Low：在 backward 传播时对梯度进行低范数正则化，有助于防止梯度爆炸并提升训练稳定性。
standard.effect: 梯度范数过大时进行额外的 norm 约束，比 clip_grad_norm 更软性（不直接截断，而是正则化）。
standard.whenToUse: 实验性功能。在 safeguard 触发梯度爆炸较频繁时可以叠加尝试。
standard.avoidWhen: 默认关闭。与 max_grad_norm 功能有部分重叠，通常选择其中一种使用。

standard_en.summary: (Experimental) BP-Low: regularises gradients towards a low norm during backward, which helps head off gradient explosions and steadies training.
standard_en.effect: Applies an extra norm constraint when the gradient norm grows too large -- softer than clip_grad_norm, since it regularises instead of clipping outright.
standard_en.whenToUse: An experimental feature. Worth stacking on when the safeguard reports gradient explosions fairly often.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Off by default. It overlaps in part with max_grad_norm, so normally you pick one or the other.

advanced.principle: BP-Low 在每次 backward 后对梯度向量添加 L2 惩罚项，拉向低范数方向，类似于优化器的 weight_decay 但作用于梯度而非权重。
advanced.tradeoffs: 低范数约束会减慢梯度方向的变化速度，可能影响收敛速度；但在高 LR 场景下显著提升稳定性。

advanced_en.principle: BP-Low adds an L2 penalty to the gradient vector after each backward, pulling it toward low norm — like optimizer weight_decay but acting on gradients rather than weights.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The low-norm constraint slows gradient-direction changes and can affect convergence speed, but markedly improves stability at high LR.
